verdict.rationale: mise's CI docs tell users to commit a lockfile and run `mise install --locked` for reproducible installs (mise-docs-70). A `mise lock` command exists (mise-docs-35), pinning is recommended (mise-docs-60), and per-platform checksums can be declared (mise-docs-26), so the core of the story is documented first-party. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of lockfile contents (resolved versions and checksums per platform across machines), behavior of `--locked` on mismatch, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the lockfile yields identical versions on every machine.
